items.english: "But it's no use leaving them here, is it? If somebody was going to live here that would be one thing, but they're going to clear it all away and before long some warehouse or other is going to be built here, isn't that the story — or have you got some idea of your own?"
"If you haven't, then keep quiet, do. It's strange, you're oddly cold about anything that's just there —"

"Here too —" she said, looking up at the house showing through the mandarin trees, amused for no reason in particular. "They say at last it's going to be cleared away before long. You must feel flat. It won't fetch a penny!"
notes: "won't fetch a penny" for 一文にもならない: literally not worth a mon, kept as small money.

items.english: "There's hardly any memories in this house, for me —" That was the sort of thing Taki said.
"But still, this makes a clean break for you. At last it's over, isn't it?"

"So the scarlet carp are what's left!" she murmured as if to herself. "Even if you thought of grilling them, there's not a single pot in this house — and yet don't you feel the least bit sentimental, about the carp, for instance?"
notes: 焼けない: I take it as grilling the carp to eat, there being no utensils in the house to be cleared; it could also point to burning the house itself, which context does not settle.

items.english: "For some reason —" Taki said with an earnest, composed air. "I feel nothing, so little that I worry even myself —"
"That must be because you're getting into your own work bit by bit. Splendid."
"You don't grumble the way you used to lately — Mother said that reassures her more than anything, she was delighted."
